# agent-soul-os

> An operating system for agent identity and memory. Give any AI agent a persistent soul, a disciplined memory, and drift detection — in plain Markdown.
>
> 给 AI Agent 的身份与记忆操作系统：持久身份、纪律化记忆、漂移裁决——纯 Markdown。

## What is this

Three installable agent skills (open SKILL.md format, cross-agent):

- **soul-bootstrap** — a 5-question interview that generates a complete identity kit (`SOUL.md` + `IDENTITY.md` + `USER.md`) with strict role separation
- **memory-layers** — a 3-layer memory protocol: what goes where, who may write, when to distill, which layer to search first
- **soul-audit** — identity drift detection plus adjudication rules distilled from real production incidents (e.g. "injection beats disk")

## Install

### Claude Code (plugin)

```
/plugin marketplace add zhaoxinghua09-cell/agent-soul-os
/plugin install agent-soul-os@agent-soul-os
```

### Any other agent (Codex / Cursor / Gemini CLI / OpenClaw)

Copy the skill folders into your agent's skills directory:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/agent-soul-os.git
cp -r agent-soul-os/skills/* /path/to/your/agent/skills/
```

### Or tell your agent to do it

```
Install agent-soul-os from github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/agent-soul-os and run soul-bootstrap on me.
```

## Key files

- skills/soul-bootstrap/SKILL.md — identity kit generator (5-question interview)
- skills/memory-layers/SKILL.md — 3-layer memory protocol with write-ownership table
- skills/soul-audit/SKILL.md — drift checklist + 5 adjudication rules
- templates/ — SOUL / IDENTITY / USER fill-in templates
- references/ — memory protocol rationale, anonymized drift incident cases
- examples/demo-agent/ — a complete worked example (fictional agent "Pip")
